description: Two wavefolders with different curves, plus a chopper that switches between them under a gate or at the input's zero crossings

params.text: Drives channel A into its wavefolder, from silence through unity to a hard fold
Drives channel B into its wavefolder, from silence through unity to a hard fold
Attenuates and inverts the CV feeding that channel's fold amount, from x-1 through zero to x1

inputs.text: The signal folded by channel A, and the signal whose zero crossings drive the chopper when the CHOPP input has no cable
The signal folded by channel B; with nothing patched here the A input feeds both channels
A gate switching the CHOPP output between the two channels, high for A and low for B; with nothing patched, channel A's zero crossings do the switching instead
Adds to that channel's fold amount, 10V covering the whole range, after that channel's attenuverter; channel B falls back to channel A's attenuated CV when nothing is patched
Adds to that channel's fold amount, 10V covering the whole range, with no attenuverter in the way

outputs.text: The two folded channels cut together, following the CHOPP gate or channel A's zero crossings

notes: both fold knobs come up fully anti-clockwise, where they pass nothing, so every output stays silent until one is turned up.
menu: Block DC on Chopp — takes the DC offset out of the chopped output; off by default
Oversampling — runs the wavefolders above the sample rate to cut aliasing: Off, x2, x4, x8 or x16, with x4 the default
